source.purpose: The starting block library: the 15 blocks from the Student Advocate reference implementation, with their design docs and journey cards.

blocks.name: egress
blocks.purpose: The one door to the network: allow-listed https hosts, named purposes, recorded

blocks.name: evidence
blocks.purpose: Append-only, pseudonymous record of what the factory and the product did

blocks.name: explore
blocks.purpose: Walks every action from every state to a fixpoint, checking invariants

blocks.name: gates
blocks.purpose: Gates that count only after planted defects make them fail; verdicts and ratchets

blocks.name: intent
blocks.purpose: Locked journey cards: goals in plain words, run in every mode and channel

blocks.name: models
blocks.purpose: Model calls behind one interface, with a twin, budgets and family labels

blocks.name: operator
blocks.purpose: Leases, idempotent dispatches confirmed by lookup, and holds

blocks.name: plain-language
blocks.purpose: Reading grade, phrase rules and carelessness checks for any text

blocks.name: privacy
blocks.purpose: Canary tracing of sensitive fields and small-cell suppression

blocks.name: review
blocks.purpose: A multi-family review panel that can fail a change, never pass one alone

blocks.name: runtime
blocks.purpose: Consent ledger, sealed facts, approvals, outbound gate and refuse-to-start

blocks.name: store
blocks.purpose: Owner-scoped document store and the classified data declaration

blocks.name: twin-service
blocks.purpose: Clock, scenarios, health and OpenAPI for synthetic services

blocks.name: twins
blocks.purpose: Twins of outside services (SMS, mail, calendars) with calibration dates

blocks.name: ui
blocks.purpose: Accessible, themed page parts shared by the app and the factory console

blocks.name: resilience
blocks.purpose: Timeouts with abort, bounded full-jitter retries, and a circuit breaker that half-opens on its own

blocks.name: idempotency
blocks.purpose: One result per idempotency key: repeats replay it, different content is refused, concurrent repeats wait

blocks.name: money
blocks.purpose: Whole minor units per currency, half-even rounding, and splits that always add back to the total

blocks.name: conflicts
blocks.purpose: Versioned saves with a three-way merge of fields that do not clash, and the exact fields that do

blocks.name: paging
blocks.purpose: Stable keyset paging with opaque cursors, and only declared sorts and filters

blocks.name: retention
blocks.purpose: Trash with dependents, restore of all of it, and a retention sweep plan with reasons

blocks.name: watchdog
blocks.purpose: Missed, overlong, failed and overlapping scheduled runs, and a lease so one copy runs at a time

blocks.name: expiry
blocks.purpose: Everything with an expiry date, and the alert each needs today

blocks.name: tree
blocks.purpose: Folders and files with stable ids, where a change re-tags every ancestor and keeps folder sizes, so sync skips unchanged subtrees

blocks.name: objects
blocks.purpose: Bytes streamed once with checksums computed on the way, byte ranges, and parts joined in the store; memory and disk stores

blocks.name: uploads
blocks.purpose: Resumable chunked uploads: any order, repeats replace, quota checked up front, joined in a tree of compose calls, idle sessions swept

blocks.name: leases
blocks.purpose: Exclusive holds with owners, tokens and time limits that end on their own, covering everything below a folder when deep

blocks.name: grants
blocks.purpose: Permissions to people, groups and links, never more than the giver has; link passwords hashed and throttled; expiries

blocks.name: devices
blocks.purpose: A browser sign-in flow that hands a new app its own hashed password once; revoke one device, or wipe it remotely

blocks.name: dav
blocks.purpose: The DAV core: a namespace-aware XML reader that refuses DTDs, the multistatus writer, and the WebDAV headers

blocks.name: oracle
blocks.purpose: Differential checks: the same requests to the reference and the candidate, answers normalised and compared, or recorded once

blocks.name: ratelimit
blocks.purpose: Token buckets per key that say how long to wait, and failure counts that slow only mistakes, with bounded memory

blocks.name: uploadsafe
blocks.purpose: Names a client could not hold refused before any bytes are kept, size limits, and the real type read from the first bytes

blocks.name: validate
blocks.purpose: One schema per input and one error format: every problem at once, each with its path and a message, as problem details for APIs and field errors for forms

blocks.name: config
blocks.purpose: Typed settings and secrets by name, refusing to start when one is missing or unsafe, an inventory that never shows a value, rotation dates and drift

blocks.name: observe
blocks.purpose: Structured logs redacted where written, errors grouped by kind and place, metrics with percentiles, and traces carried through async work

blocks.name: health
blocks.purpose: Readiness with deadlines, the running version, graceful drain on shutdown, maintenance windows, the environment badge and the status model

blocks.name: jobs
blocks.purpose: A queue with jittered retries, dead letters and replay, keyed jobs, long tasks with progress and cancel, checkpointed backfills with a dry run, and cron

blocks.name: audit
blocks.purpose: A hash-chained audit log of changes and sensitive reads, verifiable end to end and against a published head

blocks.name: crypto
blocks.purpose: Envelope encryption bound to its record with a rotating key ring, purpose-bound expiring signed tokens, constant-time comparison and random ids

blocks.name: rbac
blocks.purpose: Roles and grants declared once, narrowed by record rules, refusals that win, and the same evaluator explaining every decision and filtering lists

blocks.name: secheaders
blocks.purpose: Strict browser headers with script nonces and features off by default, session cookie attributes, and cross-site request checks

blocks.name: apikeys
blocks.purpose: Scoped API keys shown once and kept as hashes, found by prefix, rotated with an overlap, expired and revoked

blocks.name: accounts
blocks.purpose: Sign-up with confirmation, sign-in, single-use password resets, organisations and invitations, a role switcher, deactivation and offboarding, and time-boxed act-as and break-glass that are recorded and announced

blocks.name: sessions
blocks.purpose: Sessions with idle and absolute limits and a warning before expiry, ending all sessions, TOTP enrolment and checking (RFC 6238, no replay) and single-use recovery codes

blocks.name: oidc
blocks.purpose: OpenID Connect sign-in: state, nonce and PKCE, a JWKS cache, and ID token checks (RS256/ES256 only; issuer, audience, expiry, nonce)

blocks.name: webhooks
blocks.purpose: Inbound webhooks believed only when signed, recent and not seen before; outbound delivery signed, retried with backoff, parked with the last answer, replayable, with failing endpoints paused

blocks.name: flags
blocks.purpose: Feature flags for people, groups, attributes and stable percentage rollouts, a kill switch, an explanation for every answer, and a list of flags past their removal date

blocks.name: cache
blocks.purpose: Read-through cache with one load per key under load, stale-while-refresh, tags, least-recently-used eviction and hit rates; failures are not cached

blocks.name: consent
blocks.purpose: Terms and consent by version: agreement recorded with when and how, withdrawal as a new record, required re-agreement when a new version needs it

blocks.name: refdata
blocks.purpose: Versioned code lists with effective and retirement dates, labels as of a day, replacements, and checks that refuse a version which would orphan stored values

blocks.name: notify
blocks.purpose: Notifications by template (escaped, nothing missing), per-category channel choices, quiet hours in the person's zone, digests, bounce suppression, one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058), reminders that stop when done, and receipts

blocks.name: comments
blocks.purpose: Threads and replies on any record, @mentions of people who can see it, edits with history, deletion markers, reactions, resolving and unread counts, shown escaped

blocks.name: history
blocks.purpose: Field-level change history for any record: rebuild any version, compare two, undo as a new change that refuses to overwrite newer edits, and restore

blocks.name: workflow
blocks.purpose: Declared state machines checked so no record can be stranded, guards that explain, approvals by distinct people who did not ask, reasons for rejection, deadlines that escalate, and a trail

blocks.name: events
blocks.purpose: A CloudEvents 1.0 catalogue that refuses undeclared events or missing fields, a hub with replay for reconnecting clients, server-sent events, and presence

blocks.name: slo
blocks.purpose: Objectives, error budgets and multi-window burn-rate alerts; incidents with timelines and public notes; postmortems that need a cause, impact and owned actions

blocks.name: costmeter
blocks.purpose: Usage priced from a rate card and attributed to feature and tenant, free units, budgets that warn and can stop spending, and a month-end forecast

blocks.name: tabular
blocks.purpose: CSV to RFC 4180 with formula defusing, column mapping suggestions, imports that quarantine bad rows with reasons, rule-based dedupe and merge, and export to CSV, JSON lines and .xlsx

blocks.name: reports
blocks.purpose: Grouped reports with count, sum, average, min, max and distinct, filters, totals, small-group suppression, pivots, parameterised templates and scheduled delivery with a log

blocks.name: search
blocks.purpose: BM25 full-text search with field weights, accent folding and stemming, prefix while typing, phrases, facets and filters, escaped snippets, and a visibility check on every hit

blocks.name: i18n
blocks.purpose: Message catalogues with each language's plural rules, fallback chains with a missing report, Accept-Language negotiation, text direction, Intl formatting, and a completeness check

blocks.name: time
blocks.purpose: Wall time to instant across daylight-saving changes, RRULE recurrence in wall time (daily, weekly, monthly by day or weekday, yearly, until, count, exceptions), and working days

blocks.name: booking
blocks.purpose: Free time inside each person's local hours, find-a-time across zones ranked for everyone's day, and holds and bookings that cannot double-book, with buffers and expiry

blocks.name: contact
blocks.purpose: Names kept as written with a name to use and a sort key, addresses formatted and postcodes checked by country, and phone numbers normalised to E.164

blocks.name: analytics
blocks.purpose: Consent-gated product analytics with pseudonymous ids and allow-listed properties, forgetting, ordered funnels within a time limit, common journeys, and small-count suppression

blocks.name: payments
blocks.purpose: Payments behind a provider interface with a tested twin (declines, confirmation, idempotency, partial refunds), integer money, and billing: trials, renewals, prorated plan changes, retries and cancel at period end

blocks.name: pdf
blocks.purpose: PDF 1.7 written directly: headings, wrapped paragraphs, tables with repeated headers, page numbers, escaped WinAnsi text and a correct cross-reference table (checked with qpdf)

blocks.name: docparse
blocks.purpose: Text from .docx (headings, lists) and cells from .xlsx (shared and inline strings), read through a zip reader that refuses bombs, unsafe paths and damaged archives

blocks.name: imagemeta
blocks.purpose: Image kind from the bytes, size for PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP, EXIF orientation, refusal of decompression bombs, and stripping of EXIF, GPS and comments with the colour profile kept

blocks.name: geo
blocks.purpose: Great-circle distance, bounding boxes across the antimeridian, nearest places, service areas with holes, geohash, and coarsening a position to an area

blocks.name: sitemap
blocks.purpose: Head tags for public pages (canonical, Open Graph, Twitter, JSON-LD) escaped, a check for missing, long and duplicate titles, sitemaps with an index past 50,000 URLs, and robots.txt

blocks.name: apiver
blocks.purpose: Date-based API versions with per-change transforms back to a pinned version, Deprecation and Sunset headers, refusal after sunset, and a list of callers still on old versions

blocks.name: drafts
blocks.purpose: Autosaved drafts per person and record, spaced snapshots to restore, a conflict report when the record changed since, a list to pick up from, and sweeping

blocks.name: palette
blocks.purpose: A command palette with fuzzy matching, keywords, permission filtering, recent commands first, shortcut conflict detection and a shortcuts sheet

blocks.name: testdata
blocks.purpose: Seeded, repeatable fake data in ranges reserved for fiction (example domains, 555-01xx numbers, published test cards), factories with overrides, and a guard against real-looking values

blocks.name: privacy
blocks.purpose: A registry of personal-data sources; one-archive exports with a manifest and readable summary; erasure that reports removed, kept and why, and is complete only when every source succeeded

blocks.name: surfaces
blocks.purpose: A registry of every screen with its purpose, audience, help and words for loading, empty and error states, checked; contextual help, what's new once per person, a first-run checklist, and friendly error pages

blocks.name: upkeep
blocks.purpose: Dependency verdicts from advisories and current versions, expiry warnings for certificates, domains, tokens and keys, and SARIF findings with stable fingerprints, triaged into new, open, accepted and fixed

blocks.name: backups
blocks.purpose: Backups with per-collection row counts and order-free hashes, restore drills into scratch timed against a target, and grandfather-father-son retention that says why each backup is kept

blocks.name: loadsoak
blocks.purpose: Open-model load runs at a fixed arrival rate with percentile and error-rate limits, and soak verdicts that find a steady climb by fitting a line, ignoring noise

blocks.name: datagate
blocks.purpose: A classified inventory of every field with findings for gaps, a gate that allows, masks or denies each field per destination with the deciding rule, and evidence of every decision

blocks.name: pipeline
blocks.purpose: The delivery pipeline as stages and events: where each change is, what it waits for, what is stuck, and lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and time to restore

blocks.name: sync
blocks.purpose: One sync engine for outside systems: paged pulls with a cursor kept only after a page applies, pushes by external id, echo recognition, conflicts settled by a rule and reported, and twins for testing

blocks.name: feedback
blocks.purpose: Problem reports in the person's words with redacted context, grouping of similar reports, a triage board ordered by overdue and severity, and defects with evidence and a failing test skeleton

blocks.name: cmi5
blocks.purpose: cmi5 training modules: launch URLs, the defined xAPI statements with cmi5 context, the session rules, mastery scores and moveOn

blocks.name: pwa
blocks.purpose: A checked web app manifest, a service worker built from a caching plan with an offline page, and an offline queue that replays in order and sets aside what the server refuses

blocks.name: ux
blocks.purpose: Snooze to times people mean, previewed bulk edits, signed shared views, learned defaults, magic paste, honest progress, reading comfort CSS, why am I seeing this, and is it me or is it down

blocks.name: migrations
blocks.purpose: Ordered, checksummed data migrations applied once each under a lock, with verify steps, dry runs, and refusal when an applied migration was edited, removed or arrives out of order

blocks.name: mcp
blocks.purpose: Agent tools over the Model Context Protocol: a JSON-RPC 2.0 handler with initialize, tools/list and tools/call, schema-checked arguments, per-person permissions, read-only hints and a call log

blocks.name: query
blocks.purpose: A read-only query console: a small query language parsed and checked against declared collections, capped results, masked sensitive fields, no filtering on hidden values, and a log of every query

blocks.name: uat
blocks.purpose: Test-environment overrides of flags, clock and role for one tester, time-limited with a reason, shown on a banner, recorded, and refused in production

blocks.name: importer
blocks.purpose: One way in for data from anywhere: uploaded bytes or pasted text recognised as CSV/TSV, .xlsx, .docx, JSON, JSON lines, vCard, iCalendar or a pasted table or address list, decoded from UTF-8 or UTF-16, held to size and row limits, matched to fields, with every bad row quarantined by where it was and why

blocks.name: ask
blocks.purpose: Plain-language questions over a declared dataset: a model's proposed report is checked against the fields, measures and filters the person may see, small groups are suppressed, and the answer comes with its records, a plain-English description of what was computed, and the report itself

blocks.name: etl
blocks.purpose: Declared extract-transform-load pipelines with per-step page checkpoints that resume, idempotent loads by id, capped row-level error capture, dry runs, per-run lineage with an every-row-accounted check, a cron schedule and a watch for stale, failed or drifting runs

blocks.name: console
blocks.purpose: The model behind the admin console, housekeeping console and feature explorer: sections of items with status, reason, path and permission built from the app's registries, filtered by permission with a summary line, plus a feature explorer that joins and searches features, screens, flags, journeys and evidence

blocks.name: factoryreports
blocks.purpose: Feature reports, operations reports and the improvement brief as documents with tables and evidenced findings, rendered to Markdown and delivered on a schedule, with the brief ranking what to change next by weighted evidence and saying why

blocks.name: walkthrough
blocks.purpose: A guided, ordered walk through a feature's journey steps showing each claim, its evidence and whether that evidence is current, with step-by-step sign-off refused on stale, failed, missing or untraceable evidence and voided when covered code changes

blocks.name: speech
blocks.purpose: Speech transcripts turned into palette commands with spoken confirmation for destructive ones, dictation with spoken punctuation and corrections, and numbers and dates spoken in words, with a feature-detected Web Speech adapter

blocks.name: router
blocks.purpose: Chooses the cheapest model proven good enough for each kind of task: a dated price table, per-request cost with long-context and regional rates, pass rates per model per task kind trusted on a Wilson lower bound, exploration of cheaper models, escalation through tiers, judges from another family, and a daily budget

blocks.name: node-registry
blocks.purpose: Node and credential types for workflow engines: parameter schemas checked, defaults filled, credentials redacted and authenticated, versions migrated

blocks.name: execution-log
blocks.purpose: Workflow runs and steps recorded with secrets redacted as written, size caps, a readable prune plan, pinned runs and replay from any step

blocks.name: trigger-polling
blocks.purpose: Poll and webhook triggers on the job queue: deduplicated polls, test polls and test listening, and an overview of every trigger

blocks.name: storage-policies
blocks.purpose: Bucket policies with a decision engine, cleaned paths, sniffed content, signed URLs, and image transforms in one canonical form with size caps

blocks.name: webrtc-signaling
blocks.purpose: SDP read and written (RFC 8866), ICE candidates (RFC 8839), TURN credentials, signed room tokens and a signalling hub

blocks.name: call-rooms
blocks.purpose: Call rooms with roles, signed join tokens, limits and recording plans

blocks.name: icalendar
blocks.purpose: iCalendar (RFC 5545): folded content lines, events, recurrence expanded to the RFC's own examples, time zones read and written, and alarms

blocks.name: caldav
blocks.purpose: A CalDAV store: put, get, delete, calendar queries, free-busy, sync tokens and the scheduling inbox and outbox

blocks.name: rest-filter-syntax
blocks.purpose: PostgREST, Strapi and Directus filter syntaxes read into one filter tree, with range headers, an evaluator and a canonical form

blocks.name: view-engine
blocks.purpose: Saved views shared and defaulted, compiled and run without ever widening access, exported and fingerprinted

blocks.name: dashboards
blocks.purpose: Dashboards: panels, time ranges, variables, grid layout, shares and public links kept as hashes, and provisioning from files

blocks.name: dns-wire
blocks.purpose: DNS messages (RFC 1035) with name compression safe from pointer loops, EDNS(0), zone files read and written, and serial arithmetic

blocks.name: geoip
blocks.purpose: MaxMind database reader, most-specific CIDR tables, special ranges, address truncation, and locations never finer than allowed

blocks.name: text-diff
blocks.purpose: Myers diff of lines, words or characters, unified patches identical to GNU diff, applied with offsets and reversed, and moved blocks

blocks.name: oidc-provider
blocks.purpose: An OpenID Provider: discovery, rotating keys, the code flow with PKCE, ID tokens, UserInfo, pairwise subjects, revocation and logout

blocks.name: alert-rules
blocks.purpose: Alert rules that go pending, firing and resolved, with matchers, fingerprints, silences, grouping, routing and inhibition, as Alertmanager does

blocks.name: cors-cookies
blocks.purpose: CORS decisions by the Fetch standard, and cookies by RFC 6265bis: parsed, written, and kept in a jar with SameSite, domain and path rules

blocks.name: sun-calc
blocks.purpose: Sun and moon positions, sunrise and sunset including polar day and night, and moon phases, after Meeus

blocks.name: prometheus-text
blocks.purpose: Prometheus and OpenMetrics text exposition, a registry with a cardinality cap, and a parser safe on hostile input

blocks.name: svg-writer
blocks.purpose: A safe SVG writer: everything escaped, accessible titles, shapes and paths built and parsed, and text widths estimated

blocks.name: chart-spec
blocks.purpose: Declarative charts drawn to SVG with nice ticks and scales, a colour-blind-safe palette checked for contrast, and alt text

blocks.name: iam-policy
blocks.purpose: Policy evaluation as AWS IAM does it: explicit deny wins, wildcards, conditions and IP ranges, and policies validated

blocks.name: identity-brokering
blocks.purpose: Sign-in through other identity providers, with account linking that refuses pre-hijack and issuer mix-up, role mapping and unlinking

blocks.name: columnar-agg
blocks.purpose: A small column store: filters, group-by, approximate distinct counts and time rollups corrected for late data

blocks.name: access-policy
blocks.purpose: Forward-auth rules: paths normalised and double encoding refused, hosts and address ranges, a guard on slow patterns, and every decision explained

blocks.name: email-threading
blocks.purpose: Mail threads by the JWZ method, base subjects (RFC 5256), encoded words (RFC 2047), auto-reply rules (RFC 3834) and reply headers

blocks.name: login-flows
blocks.purpose: Declared login flows with step-up, required actions, brute-force lockout, and failures that never say whether an account exists

blocks.name: stats-basic
blocks.purpose: Descriptive statistics and quantiles, common distributions, t and chi-square tests, confidence intervals, effect sizes and power

blocks.name: cert-store
blocks.purpose: Certificates read with a strict DER reader, chains built and checked, host names matched (RFC 9525), and expiry alerts

blocks.name: subscriber-lists
blocks.purpose: Mailing lists with double opt-in, one-click unsubscribe (RFC 8058), preferences, suppression kept as keyed hashes, consent evidence and CSV

blocks.name: webhook-catalog
blocks.purpose: Outgoing webhook events declared once: schemas checked, sample payloads, and a delivery log per subscriber

blocks.name: template-engine
blocks.purpose: A logic-light template language: escaped by default, filters, includes and a step limit so no template can run away

blocks.name: tenant-model
blocks.purpose: Tenant isolation: a store scoped to the tenant, keys per tenant, quotas and fair shares, and permissions through roles

blocks.name: smtp-protocol
blocks.purpose: SMTP and ESMTP client and server state machines: STARTTLS, AUTH, pipelining and reply parsing

blocks.name: mail-queue
blocks.purpose: Outbound mail decisions: the retry curve, state per receiving domain, and sender warm-up

blocks.name: api-client
blocks.purpose: Calls to outside APIs only to allowed hosts, with rate limits honoured, paging, and a circuit breaker

blocks.name: html-sanitize
blocks.purpose: Allow-list HTML cleaning in three strengths, for comments, posts and rich pages

blocks.name: zip-write
blocks.purpose: ZIP (with ZIP64) and tar written as streams, and read back, checked against Python's zipfile and GNU tar

blocks.name: jwt
blocks.purpose: JSON Web Signatures signed and verified, claims checked, key sets rotated and revoked, JWKS and thumbprints (RFC 7515, 7638, 8037)

blocks.name: ldap
blocks.purpose: LDAP names and filters (RFC 4514, 4515), a directory with scoped and paged search, safe binds, nested groups mapped to roles, and user sync

blocks.name: webpush
blocks.purpose: Web Push: VAPID, payloads encrypted to RFC 8291 byte for byte, requests checked, and subscriptions kept sealed and pruned on 404 and 410

blocks.name: credential-vault
blocks.purpose: Stored credentials sealed to their owner, shared by level with expiry, sent only to their own hosts, refreshed one at a time and rotated

blocks.name: workflow-graph
blocks.purpose: Workflow graphs with branches, merges, loops, waits and per-item retries, validated, and run step by step as plain JSON on the job queue

blocks.name: timeseries
blocks.purpose: Time series downsampled and rolled up so rollups of rollups agree, counter rates across resets, gaps found and filled, tiered retention

blocks.name: json-patch
blocks.purpose: JSON Pointer, JSON Patch and Merge Patch (RFC 6901, 6902, 7396) applied atomically, diffed, inverted and merged three ways

blocks.name: websocket-frames
blocks.purpose: WebSocket (RFC 6455): the handshake, frames with masking and length rules, close codes, ping and pong, and backpressure

blocks.name: ws-rpc
blocks.purpose: Requests and subscriptions over WebSocket: sign-in first, allowed topics, signed resume tokens with replay, and slow clients closed

blocks.name: magic-links
blocks.purpose: Sign-in links and codes by email, stored as keyed hashes, bound to the device, safe from mail scanners, and throttled

blocks.name: token-service
blocks.purpose: Access and refresh tokens: RFC 9068 access tokens, rotating refresh with reuse detection, introspection, revocation, exchange and binding

blocks.name: webauthn
blocks.purpose: Passkeys: registration and sign-in with COSE keys, authenticator data, counters and backup flags, and none, packed and U2F attestation

blocks.name: document-templates
blocks.purpose: Document templates merged strictly with roles and repeaters, frozen by content hash, and a stamped PDF footer

blocks.name: mime
blocks.purpose: Mail messages read and built (RFC 5322, 2045, 2047, 2231): folding, encoded words, quoted-printable and attachments

blocks.name: pdf-parse
blocks.purpose: PDF read with both kinds of cross-reference, object streams and repair, text extracted, and pages split, merged and rotated

blocks.name: asn1-der
blocks.purpose: A strict DER reader and canonical writer, with X.509 certificates and certificate requests

blocks.name: email-html
blocks.purpose: HTML for email: allow-list cleaning, CSS inlined by real specificity, tracked links, a plain-text part and a client-support report

blocks.name: password-policy
blocks.purpose: Password rules after NIST 800-63B: strength by guess count, breached-password checks by k-anonymity, and reuse history

blocks.name: argon2id
blocks.purpose: Argon2id, Argon2i and Argon2d (RFC 9106) and BLAKE2b (RFC 7693) in plain TypeScript, with every RFC vector

blocks.name: password-hash
blocks.purpose: Password hashing over Argon2id, scrypt and PBKDF2 with a rotating pepper, rehash on sign-in, and equal timing for unknown users

blocks.name: xml-dsig
blocks.purpose: XML signatures: exclusive canonicalisation, signing and verifying, with signature wrapping refused

blocks.name: saml
blocks.purpose: A SAML 2.0 service provider: signed requests, strict response checks, replay refused, and metadata written and read

blocks.name: client-registry
blocks.purpose: OAuth clients registered (RFC 7591, 7592), secrets rotated with an overlap, redirect addresses matched exactly, and scopes filtered

blocks.name: oauth2-server
blocks.purpose: An OAuth 2.1 authorisation server: PKCE, the device flow, rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection, introspection and revocation

blocks.name: thumbnails
blocks.purpose: Images resized five ways with orientation applied, crop and fit planned, derivatives keyed for the cache, and PNG built in

blocks.name: markdown
blocks.purpose: CommonMark and GitHub-flavoured Markdown read to a tree and written to safe HTML, with heading ids and front matter

blocks.name: custom-fields
blocks.purpose: Custom fields people add to records: typed, stored, indexed, redacted and kept unique where asked

blocks.name: toc-outline
blocks.purpose: Tables of contents and outlines with stable anchors, section ranges, word counts, reading time and excerpts

blocks.name: scim
blocks.purpose: A SCIM 2.0 server (RFC 7643, 7644): filters, patch operations, ETags, bulk requests and discovery

blocks.name: snapshot-restore
blocks.purpose: Snapshots hashed and compared, and a restore planned, confirmed by code, applied and verified

blocks.name: expression-engine
blocks.purpose: A sandboxed expression language for templates and workflows, with allowed methods only and limits on steps, size and memory

blocks.name: json-schema
blocks.purpose: JSON Schema 2020-12: validation with references and error paths, schemas inferred from samples, examples generated, and breaking changes found

blocks.name: wiki-pages
blocks.purpose: Wiki pages in a tree with revisions, templates, inherited permissions, edit locks and backlinks

blocks.name: multipart-parse
blocks.purpose: Form uploads (RFC 7578) parsed as they stream, with limits enforced as bytes arrive, real types checked and file names made safe

blocks.name: llm-provider
blocks.purpose: One request shape over model vendors: streaming, tool calls, structured output with repair, retries and fallbacks, a twin, and cost records

blocks.name: agent-loop
blocks.purpose: A bounded agent loop: budgets for steps, tools, cost, tokens and time, repeats caught, tools checked, approvals that suspend and resume, and a trace

blocks.name: jsonpath
blocks.purpose: JSONPath (RFC 9535) with slices, filters and typed functions, normalised paths and limits, and a jq-like transform

blocks.name: entity-registry
blocks.purpose: A registry of devices, entities and areas as Home Assistant keeps it: devices merged by identifiers, renames that keep old ids, and areas without loops

blocks.name: automation-engine
blocks.purpose: Automations: triggers, conditions and actions with single, restart, queued and parallel modes, a safe template language, and traces

blocks.name: plugin-manifest
blocks.purpose: Plugin manifests checked all at once, permissions reviewed, packages signed with Ed25519 against scoped trust, and install plans in dependency order

blocks.name: relations
blocks.purpose: Relations between records: belongs-to, one-to-one, ordered many-to-many and soft links, with delete plans and orphan repair

blocks.name: media-assets
blocks.purpose: A media library: real types sniffed, dangerous SVG refused, usage tracked, alt text reported, derivatives and srcset planned

blocks.name: i18n-content
blocks.purpose: Content in many languages: variants that know when they are stale, review, machine translation with placeholders kept, and alternates

blocks.name: avatars
blocks.purpose: Avatars: Gravatar hashes, identicons and initials on a palette checked for contrast, sizes and srcset

blocks.name: emoji
blocks.purpose: Emoji found whole across joiners and skin tones, shortcodes, a custom set, safe HTML and reactions

blocks.name: content-versions
blocks.purpose: Content revisions with conflict detection, publish, schedule and roll back, field and text diffs, and signed preview links

blocks.name: hooks
blocks.purpose: Actions and filters as WordPress has them: priorities, run-once, owners, a declared catalogue, deprecations forwarded, and async forms
